comment_regular: Verified cell linking: calls ExtraDataList_ResolveLoadedFormIDs before ownership policy. XOWN case 0x27 rebases the stored FormID, resolves it via TESForm_LookupByFormID, and stores the TESForm*; missing owners remove the extra. For an exterior cell (interior flag bit 0 clear) with direct XOWN, LinkForm logs a removal and clears XOWN, XRNK, and XGLB. Interior cells keep those ownership fields.
